name: Kokuhaku ~Suki na no Onii-chan!~
original_name: こくはく ～好きなのお兄ちゃん!～
source:
After two years you end up living with your two little twin sisters in law Manatsu & Mahiro who have grown up to be beautiful girls. As a new temporary teacher for the academy that the uncle that raised them manages, you are always with your sisters in law at school as well as at home.

So with all of you under one roof, which one will you choose?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ033198.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
两年后，你最终和你的两个双胞胎小姨子真夏和真希生活在一起，她们已经长大成为漂亮的女孩。作为抚养他们的叔叔管理的学院的新临时老师，无论在学校还是在家里，你总是和嫂子们在一起。

那么，当你们所有人同在一个屋檐下时，你会选择哪一个呢？

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ033198.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
